lop_cr01h.by: DA rev 116 (13 RCU / 0 OOE, re:RI-26; RA rev 129, AR 337, TI rev 396)
lop_cr01h.why: RCU's in-side 13 on the zero-cycle issue end's lead_opcode (RA-43): OOE drives it from its lead flop, wire only, declared required 0 on OOE's side (0 + 13 <= 25). rcu_cls_a1 reaches the class flops 12.2 to 12.4 after it with the fanout term. Only the four class-word lead fields take 13; every other lead field and the payload stay at 12.
